title: SOUVENIR WALL NOOK
description: Homes now include a small memory nook where pets, races, harvest festivals, and dungeon clears leave tiny display objects with optional frames and shelf trims.
consequence: The house starts keeping receipts emotionally.

title: HEIRLOOM TOOL REPAIR
description: Favorite tools can now be restored at camp with scratches, names, and old upgrade history intact instead of being replaced by cleaner shop versions.
consequence: The pickaxe refuses to become a shopping trip.

title: COMPANION LOADOUT SLOT
description: Companions now equip swappable perk modules, color kits, and tactical poses, turning their personality screen into a small rotating build menu.
consequence: The companion slot starts acting like a wardrobe.

title: ROTATING TAVERN CREW
description: Quest hubs now refresh support NPCs weekly with new names, temporary favors, and contract tags so the town feels busier without anyone settling in.
consequence: The tavern fills with names that do not stick.
